Place start.gro, bilayer.mdp, topol.top, and the four ITP files in the bilayer directory, then run bash run_bilayer.sh.

Equal planar and normal pressure targets specify a condition without an imposed pressure difference between those directions. Instantaneous pressure still fluctuates in a finite system, and the two leaflets may carry different internal stresses. In particular, this assembly places 66 lipids on one side and 62 on the other. Changing box area does not automatically equalize their populations. Moving a lipid between leaflets requires its head to traverse an unfavorable membrane environment and constitutes another rearrangement process. Leaflet identities remain unchanged across the saved frames of this continuation, so the area analysis retains the actual membership as part of the studied system.

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g15/en/#en-s5)

Figure 2 · Side-view schematic with heads outward and tails inward. Labels 66/62 give actual leaflet populations; circles schematically represent each leaflet. Area is the projection viewed along z.

The semiisotropic record still fluctuates as the membrane and box dimensions adjust. We use the 151 frames from 15 to 30 ns of this second stage for the structural summaries and display the complete time series alongside them. The common interval ensures that the different observables refer to the same records, with explicit duration, sampling interval, and leaflet populations. Future comparisons involving temperature, hydration, or lipid chemistry should examine the dimensional relaxation of each system before selecting corresponding analysis intervals. Matching definitions and understanding the state being sampled are what make differences between resulting distributions interpretable.

## One membrane and two areas per lipid

Viewed from above, a planar membrane has projected area equal to the product of the x and y box lengths. Picture two shelves occupying the same footprint but carrying different numbers of books. The common footprint divided by the number on each shelf gives a different average area allocation. Similarly, both membrane leaflets cover the same projected area, but area per lipid must use each leaflet's own molecular count. Dividing 128 by two assumes equal populations of 64. The actual populations here are 66 and 62, so the two denominators should be retained when describing the membrane's two sides.

Use each leaflet’s actual populationEq. 3

![Use each leaflet’s actual population](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/e8854a3a726d249227fd94d3.svg)

| Symbol | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lx, Ly | Orthogonal box lengths in the membrane plane | nm |
| A | Projected membrane area | nm² |
| N+, N− | Fixed positive-z and negative-z leaflet populations, 66 and 62 | 1 |
| a+, a− | Mean projected area per lipid in each leaflet | nm² |
| +, − | Subscripts distinguish leaflet orientation | 1 |
| =, +, ×, / | Equality, addition, multiplication and division; adjacent symbols multiply | 1 |

Reading the relationshipBoth leaflets share the projected box area; dividing by their own counts gives different mean allocations.

A worked exampleAt A=38.4734 nm², a+=38.4734/66≈0.58293 nm² and a−=38.4734/62≈0.62054 nm².

ConditionsFor projected area of a planar membrane; local molecular area and curved surface area require additional definitions.

The mean projected area over the final 15 ns is 38.473 nm². Division by 66 gives 0.583 nm² for the positive-z leaflet, while division by 62 gives 0.621 nm² for the other leaflet. Their curves rise and fall together because every frame contributes one shared box area and two fixed denominators. The corresponding standard deviations across saved frames are about 0.022 and 0.024 nm². These values describe fluctuations within the record. Area per lipid is an average allocation of a leaflet's total area; individual molecules move through a shared membrane rather than occupy fixed little squares. Local packing requires an additional spatial partitioning definition.

### Leaflet area, phosphate separation, and collective alignment

Fixed 66/62 leaflet memberships; shading marks the 151-frame interval from 15 to 30 ns.

128 Martini 3 DSPC lipids and 768 W beads at 340 K and 1 bar. Thirty ns of isotropic self-assembly is followed by rotation of all positions and velocities to a z-normal membrane and 30 ns of semi-isotropic sampling. Uses PC/bonded v2 lipid parameters.

[Download reference data and complete inputs (ZIP) 5.97 MB](https://github.com/GellmanSparrowS/ml-biomat-blog/releases/download/md-courses-2026-11/gromacs-dspc-reference-data.zip)

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g15/en/#en-s6)

Thirty ns after rotation: projected areas per lipid using fixed 66/62 memberships, PO4-plane separation and collective alignment. The 15–30 ns interval contains 151 saved times.

Thickness also requires specifying where the ruler is placed. Here it is the separation of the mean PO4 positions in the two leaflets. The program first finds the membrane's periodic midplane from terminal tail positions, places the headgroup coordinates on either side of that center, and then subtracts their leaflet averages. This resolves the seam visible in the assembly snapshots. The shorter straight interval between headgroup layers inside the displayed box can be the water layer, so selecting that interval would measure the wrong region. Locating the tail-rich interior ensures that the measurement follows the same membrane as it crosses a boundary.

Measure headgroup planes across the membrane interiorEq. 4

![Measure headgroup planes across the membrane interior](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/d32f0d6867dbb3521dbef182.svg)

| Symbol | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dPP | Separation of leaflet mean PO4 planes | nm |
| zᵢ, zⱼ | PO4 normal coordinates unfolded about the periodic terminal-tail midplane | nm |
| i, j | Lipid indices in the two leaflets | 1 |
| N+, N− | Leaflet membership counts, 66 and 62 | 1 |
| Σ, ∈, +, − | Sum over the specified leaflet; set membership; + and − in summation labels identify leaflets, while the central − subtracts | 1 |
| =, / | Equality and division; dividing a sum by population gives its mean | 1 |

Reading the relationshipAverage head coordinates on each side and subtract. Tail-midplane centering makes the separation cross the membrane interior.

A worked exampleIf the mean coordinates are +2.1 and −2.2 nm, dPP=2.1−(−2.2)=4.3 nm.

ConditionsFor this nearly planar membrane, fixed leaflet memberships, and z normal; the observable is specifically PO4-plane separation.

The resulting mean phosphate-plane separation is 4.321 nm, with a frame-to-frame standard deviation of 0.122 nm. Portions of the time series with larger area often have a smaller headgroup separation, consistent with the geometrical idea that lateral spreading can accompany thinning. Molecular tilt, tail bending, and hydration participate as well. A quantitative relationship between these observables would require their joint distribution and temporal correlations; the shapes of two curves alone do not reduce membrane deformation to one fixed-volume mechanism. Here they serve as connected structural measurements whose coordinates, directions, and averaging populations have been specified.

Experimental and computational thicknesses can refer to different boundaries: headgroup density peaks, the hydrophobic core, or a length inferred from fitting scattering data. A useful comparison begins by asking which material the experiment detects and then constructing a corresponding simulated observable. The mean PO4 planes are convenient for following changes within this model. The bead-density profile in the next section adds information beyond two mean positions, including the widths of headgroup layers and the transitions between tail-rich and water-rich regions. Centering each frame also separates internal structure from translation of the membrane as a whole.

## Read the membrane interior through density and orientation

A density profile is built much like counting people in equal sections of a long corridor. Divide the membrane-normal coordinate into 0.1 nm slices. Each slice has volume equal to the current membrane area multiplied by its thickness; the number of beads in the slice divided by that volume gives number density. We count PO4, all tail beads, and W separately, centering every frame on the terminal-tail midplane before averaging over the final 15 ns. This keeps the membrane interior at zero and avoids broadening the headgroup peaks through collective translation. Each frame uses its own area because pressure coupling changes the box.

Divide counts by slice volume, then average framesEq. 5

![Divide counts by slice volume, then average frames](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/9e894015e70b4cb954e7f164.svg)

| Symbol | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| k, f, F | Slice index, frame index, and analysis frame count, 151 | 1 |
| nₖ, f | Selected bead count in slice k of frame f | 1 |
| Af | Projected membrane area in that frame | nm² |
| Δz | Slice width, 0.1 here | nm |
| AfΔz | Slice volume in that frame | nm³ |
| ρ̄ₖ | Mean bead number density | nm⁻³ |
| Σ, 1/F, =, /, × | Frame summation, frame averaging, equality, division and multiplication | 1 |

Reading the relationshipNormalize each frame by its actual slice volume before averaging, retaining area changes under pressure coupling.

A worked exampleWith area 40 nm², slice width 0.1 nm and eight beads, density is 8/(40×0.1)=2 nm⁻³.

ConditionsCount PO4, all tail beads, or W separately after centering. Integration over z gives mean bead count per area; W is counted as beads.

The profile places tail beads in the center, PO4 peaks on both sides, and most water beads farther outside, matching the chemical organization of a bilayer. Curve heights reflect both spatial concentration and the total number of selected beads. Each lipid has one PO4 bead but eight tail beads, so their integrated densities differ accordingly. Integrating number density over z gives the number of beads per projected area, a relation checked by the program. W density counts water beads; nominal water-molecule density requires a factor of four. Electron density and mass density would instead require the corresponding electron or mass weights.

### Bead density and tail alignment inside the membrane

Final 15 ns, centered on the periodic terminal-tail midplane. Density is in nm⁻³; P₂ bars show sample standard deviations of frame-wise molecular averages.

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g15/en/#en-s7)

Bead number densities relative to the periodic terminal-tail midplane and P₂ of six adjacent tail-bead links over the final 15 ns. Error bars are sample standard deviations of frame-wise molecular means; link alignment and the molecular-axis eigenvalue are distinct definitions.

Tail orientation supplies another view of the interior. Take a line joining two neighboring tail beads, measure its angle to the z normal, and convert that angle to P₂. A bond parallel or antiparallel to the normal gives 1, while a bond lying in the membrane plane gives −0.5. For an isotropic three-dimensional distribution, the average squared cosine is one third, giving average P₂ equal to zero. Calculate the squared cosine for each bond before averaging over molecules and frames. Averaging angles first and then squaring their cosine produces a different quantity, particularly when opposing leaflets contribute opposite directions.

Average squared projections of individual bondsEq. 6

![Average squared projections of individual bonds](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/fd8cee8e4e7ddfbb77f3af22.svg)

| Symbol | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P₂ | Second-rank orientation parameter relative to the membrane normal | 1 |
| θ | Angle between a coarse-grained tail-bond vector and the +z normal | ° |
| b, bz | Vector joining adjacent tail beads and its z component | nm |
| ‖b‖ | Vector magnitude | nm |
| cos θ, cos² θ | Cosine formed from the length ratio and its square | 1 |
| ⟨·⟩ | Compute for each bond, then average over selected molecules and frames | 1 |
| 3, 1, 2 | Dimensionless constants setting the orientation scale | 1 |
| =, −, /, ², ‖·‖ | Equality, subtraction, division, squaring and vector magnitude | 1 |

Reading the relationshipSquaring treats opposite directions equally. The isotropic mean squared cosine is 1/3, so the expression gives zero in that limit.

A worked exampleBoth 0° and 180° give one; 90° gives −0.5. Equal 0° and 180° directions have mean P₂=1 although their mean angle is 90°.

ConditionsComputed separately for six tail connections with z as the membrane normal; averaging angles first changes the observable.

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g15/en/#en-s7)

Figure 3 · Directions at 0° and 180° both follow the normal and give P₂=1. A 90° direction lies in the plane and gives −0.5. The three-dimensional isotropic average is zero.

For the two tails, the C1–C2 bonds nearer the connecting region have mean P₂ values of approximately 0.571 and 0.597. The terminal C3–C4 bonds give about 0.432 and 0.430. The lower terminal values indicate more dispersed squared projections onto the normal, consistent with greater freedom for the ends to bend. The plotted bars show the standard deviation among 151 frame means, each already averaged over 128 molecules. They describe fluctuations in the sampled record; temporal correlation also enters uncertainty of the mean. Local tail-bond P₂ and the earlier whole-lipid alignment S use different vectors and should retain those separate definitions.

Four equal-weight directions: compare averaging evaluated orientations with evaluating an average angle.

[Figure: Four directions relative to the membrane normal](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g15/en/#en-s7)

The dashed line indicates the membrane plane and vertical lines its normal. Vectors have equal weight; 0° and 180° share the same squared axial projection.

The interaction places four equally weighted directions in one plane to make the order of operations visible. In the same-angle setting, all four directions have angle θ. In the opposing setting, half have angle θ and half have angle 180°−θ. At zero degrees, two arrows point upward and two downward, yet P₂ remains 1. At 90°, all lie in the membrane plane and P₂ becomes −0.5. This is a geometrical example of the angular definition. Recorded molecular directions occupy three-dimensional space, and applying the same operation to each selected vector handles both leaflets and different positions along each tail.

## Turn an assembly record into a model for further study

The complete analysis requires the TPR and XTC files from the two stages. It first checks the 128 twelve-bead DSPC molecules, 768 W beads, and their bead ordering. It then follows the topology connections to reconstruct each molecule across periodic boundaries. Checking every connection and cycle prevents a boundary-cut tail from being interpreted as an unusually stretched molecule. Whole-molecule coordinates supply directions and bond angles, while periodic centering supplies positions for density calculations. Time series, numerical summaries, and plots are saved together, linking area, thickness, and orientation to the same frames and stated analysis window.

### Complete assembly and bilayer analysis

```
"""Read DSPC assembly and bilayer trajectories and measure their organization.

python analyze_lipids.py --assembly records/assembly --bilayer records/bilayer \
    --out analysis --language en
The two directories contain assembly.tpr/xtc and bilayer.tpr/xtc respectively.
Dependencies: MDAnalysis, NumPy, Matplotlib. MDAnalysis lengths are angstrom.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import csv
import json
import numpy as np
import MDAnalysis as mda
from MDAnalysis.lib.distances import minimize_vectors
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager


def plans(group):
    index = {int(x): i for i, x in enumerate(group.indices)}
    edges = np.array([[index[int(a)], index[int(b)]] for a, b in group.bonds.indices])
    graph = [[] for _ in group]
    for k, (a, b) in enumerate(edges):
        graph[a].append((b, k, 1)); graph[b].append((a, k, -1))
    queue, seen, plan = [0], {0}, []
    for a in queue:
        for b, k, sign in graph[a]:
            if b not in seen:
                queue.append(b); seen.add(b); plan.append((a, b, k, sign))
    if len(seen) != 12:
        raise ValueError("Each DSPC molecule must have a connected 12-bead graph")
    return edges, plan


def reconstruct(raw, box, edges, plan):
    # Apply one identical molecular topology to all 128 lipids in this frame.
    delta = raw[:, edges[:, 1]]-raw[:, edges[:, 0]]
    delta = minimize_vectors(delta.reshape(-1, 3), box).reshape(delta.shape)
    xyz = np.empty_like(raw, dtype=float); xyz[:, 0] = raw[:, 0]
    for a, b, k, sign in plan:
        xyz[:, b] = xyz[:, a]+sign*delta[:, k]
    actual = xyz[:, edges[:, 1]]-xyz[:, edges[:, 0]]
    if np.max(np.linalg.norm(actual-delta, axis=-1)) > .005:
        raise ValueError("Periodic bond-cycle closure failed")
    longest = float(np.linalg.norm(actual, axis=-1).max()/10)
    if longest > .8:
        raise ValueError("A coarse-grained bonded distance exceeds 0.8 nm")
    return xyz/10, longest


def statistics(a):
    return {"mean": float(np.mean(a)), "sd": float(np.std(a, ddof=1))}


def save(fig, path):
    fig.savefig(path.with_suffix(".svg"))
    fig.savefig(path.with_suffix(".png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--assembly", type=Path, default=Path("records/assembly"))
    p.add_argument("--bilayer", type=Path, default=Path("records/bilayer"))
    p.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("analysis"))
    p.add_argument("--language", choices=["zh", "en"], default="en")
    args = p.parse_args(); args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    zh = args.language == "zh"
    available = {f.name for f in font_manager.fontManager.ttflist}
    families = ["Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC",
                "WenQuanYi Zen Hei", "DejaVu Sans"] if zh else ["DejaVu Sans"]
    plt.rcParams.update({"font.family": [n for n in families if n in available],
                         "font.size": 14, "axes.labelsize": 15,
                         "svg.fonttype": "path", "axes.unicode_minus": False,
                         "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
    expected_names = ["NC3", "PO4", "GL1", "GL2", "C1A", "C2A", "C3A", "C4A",
                      "C1B", "C2B", "C3B", "C4B"]
    tail_pairs = [(4, 5), (5, 6), (6, 7), (8, 9), (9, 10), (10, 11)]
    arrays = {}; snapshots = []; maximum_bond = 0.; initial_side = None
    density_edges = np.linspace(-4, 4, 81)
    density = np.zeros((3, 80)); expected_integral = np.zeros(3)
    order = []; leaflet_changes = 0; late_frames = 0
    for name, folder in [("assembly", args.assembly), ("bilayer", args.bilayer)]:
        u = mda.Universe(str(folder/f"{name}.tpr"), str(folder/f"{name}.xtc"))
        lipids = u.select_atoms("resname DSPC")
        water = u.select_atoms("resname W")
        if len(u.atoms) != 2304 or len(lipids) != 1536 or len(water) != 768:
            raise ValueError("Expected 128 DSPC molecules and 768 W beads")
        if list(lipids.names) != expected_names*128 or abs(sum(lipids.charges)) > 1e-5:
            raise ValueError("DSPC bead ordering or charge differs from this model")
        edges, plan = plans(lipids[:12]); rows = []
        for frame in u.trajectory:
            if not np.allclose(frame.dimensions[3:], 90):
                raise ValueError("This analysis uses the recorded orthorhombic boxes")
            box = frame.dimensions[:3].astype(float)/10
            xyz, longest = reconstruct(lipids.positions.astype(float).reshape(128, 12, 3), frame.dimensions, edges, plan)
            maximum_bond = max(maximum_bond, longest)
            head = xyz[:, 1]; tail = xyz[:, [7, 11]]
            direction = head-tail.mean(axis=1)
            direction /= np.linalg.norm(direction, axis=1)[:, None]
            q = 1.5*direction.T@direction/128-.5*np.eye(3)
            eig, axes = np.linalg.eigh(q); axis = axes[:, -1]
            row = [float(frame.time), float(eig[-1]), *np.abs(axis)]
            if name == "assembly" and frame.frame in [0, 50, 150, 300]:
                snapshots.append({"time_ps": float(frame.time), "box_nm": box.tolist(),
                                  "lipid_coordinates_nm": (xyz % box).tolist(),
                                  "water_coordinates_nm": (water.positions/10 % box).tolist()})
            if name == "bilayer":
                side = direction[:, 2] > 0
                if initial_side is None:
                    initial_side = side.copy()
                    if [int(side.sum()), int((~side).sum())] != [66, 62]:
                        raise ValueError("Expected the recorded 66/62 leaflet membership")
                leaflet_changes += int(np.sum(side != initial_side))
                # A circular mean locates the tail midplane across the periodic seam.
                phase = np.mean(np.exp(2j*np.pi*tail[:, :, 2]/box[2]))
                if abs(phase) < .1:
                    raise ValueError("Tail positions do not define one clear midplane")
                center = np.angle(phase)*box[2]/(2*np.pi)
                hz = head[:, 2]-center; hz -= box[2]*np.round(hz/box[2])
                area = box[0]*box[1]
                thickness = hz[initial_side].mean()-hz[~initial_side].mean()
                row += [float(area), float(area/66), float(area/62), float(thickness)]
                if frame.time >= 15000:
                    late_frames += 1
                    groups = [xyz[:, 1, 2], xyz[:, 4:, 2].ravel(), water.positions[:, 2]/10]
                    for k, z in enumerate(groups):
                        centered = z-center; centered -= box[2]*np.round(centered/box[2])
                        counts, _ = np.histogram(centered, bins=density_edges)
                        if counts.sum() != len(z):
                            raise ValueError("Density interval does not cover all selected beads")
                        density[k] += counts/(area*np.diff(density_edges))
                        expected_integral[k] += len(z)/area
                    bond = np.stack([xyz[:, b]-xyz[:, a] for a, b in tail_pairs], axis=1)
                    cos2 = bond[:, :, 2]**2/np.sum(bond*bond, axis=-1)
                    order.append((1.5*cos2-.5).mean(axis=0))
            rows.append(row)
        values = np.asarray(rows)
        if len(values) != 301 or not np.allclose(values[:, 0], np.arange(301)*100):
            raise ValueError("Expected 301 saved frames spanning 0–30000 ps")
        arrays[name] = values
        fields = ["time_ps", "nematic_eigenvalue", "axis_abs_x", "axis_abs_y", "axis_abs_z"]
        if name == "bilayer":
            fields += ["area_nm2", "area_positive_nm2", "area_negative_nm2", "phosphate_separation_nm"]
        with (args.out/f"{name}.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            writer = csv.writer(f); writer.writerow(fields); writer.writerows(values)
    density /= late_frames; expected_integral /= late_frames
    actual_integral = np.sum(density*np.diff(density_edges), axis=1)
    if not np.allclose(actual_integral, expected_integral, rtol=1e-12):
        raise ValueError("Density integral check failed")
    order = np.asarray(order); late = arrays["bilayer"][150:]
    summary = {"model": "128 DSPC, Martini 3 regular v3.0.0 + PC/bonded v2; 768 W; 340 K",
               "frames_per_stage": 301, "bilayer_late_frames": late_frames,
               "bilayer_window_ps": [15000, 30000], "leaflet_counts": [66, 62],
               "leaflet_orientation_changes": leaflet_changes, "maximum_bond_nm": maximum_bond,
               "assembly_final_nematic_eigenvalue": arrays["assembly"][-1, 1],
               "assembly_final_axis_absolute": arrays["assembly"][-1, 2:5].tolist(),
               "bilayer_last15ns": {n: statistics(late[:, j]) for n, j in [
                   ("nematic_eigenvalue", 1), ("area_nm2", 5), ("area_positive_nm2", 6),
                   ("area_negative_nm2", 7), ("phosphate_separation_nm", 8)]},
               "tail_bond_labels": [f"{expected_names[a]}–{expected_names[b]}" for a, b in tail_pairs],
               "tail_bond_P2_mean": order.mean(axis=0).tolist(),
               "tail_bond_P2_frame_sd": order.std(axis=0, ddof=1).tolist(),
               "density_integral_per_nm2": actual_integral.tolist(),
               "density_expected_mean_count_over_area_per_nm2": expected_integral.tolist(),
               "sd_definition": "Sample standard deviation across saved frames, ddof=1"}
    (args.out/"summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    (args.out/"snapshots.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshots), encoding="utf-8")
    np.savetxt(args.out/"density.csv", np.column_stack(((density_edges[:-1]+density_edges[1:])/2, density.T)),
               delimiter=",", header="z_nm,PO4_per_nm3,tail_beads_per_nm3,W_per_nm3", comments="")
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10), constrained_layout=True)
    for ax, frame in zip(axs.ravel(), snapshots):
        xyz = np.asarray(frame["lipid_coordinates_nm"]); w = np.asarray(frame["water_coordinates_nm"])
        ax.scatter(w[:, 0], w[:, 1], s=7, c="#aabfce", alpha=.35)
        ax.scatter(xyz[:, 4:, 0], xyz[:, 4:, 1], s=8, c="#d2974f", alpha=.45)
        ax.scatter(xyz[:, 1, 0], xyz[:, 1, 1], s=27, c="#147d92", edgecolors="none")
        ax.set(xlabel="x / nm", ylabel="y / nm", xlim=(0, frame["box_nm"][0]),
               ylim=(0, frame["box_nm"][1]), aspect="equal", title=f'{frame["time_ps"]/1000:g} ns')
    fig.suptitle("自组装轨迹：磷酸头基、尾珠与水珠的 xy 投影" if zh else
                 "Assembly trajectory: xy projections of phosphate heads, tails, and water", fontsize=16)
    save(fig, args.out/"assembly-structure")
    a = arrays["assembly"]
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 8), sharex=True, constrained_layout=True)
    axs[0].plot(a[:, 0]/1000, a[:, 1], c="#147d92", lw=1.8)
    axs[0].set_ylabel("最大取向特征值 S" if zh else "Largest alignment\neigenvalue S")
    for j, color in enumerate(["#c66b43", "#147d92", "#7566a8"]):
        axs[1].plot(a[:, 0]/1000, a[:, j+2], label=f"|n{'xyz'[j]}|", color=color, lw=1.4)
    axs[1].set_ylabel("主轴单位向量的绝对分量" if zh else "Principal-axis components\n(absolute values)")
    axs[1].set_xlabel("自组装阶段时间 / ns" if zh else "Assembly-stage time / ns")
    axs[1].legend(ncol=3); axs[0].set_title("共同朝向随聚集逐渐出现" if zh else "A common orientation develops during aggregation")
    for ax in axs: ax.grid(alpha=.15)
    save(fig, args.out/"assembly-order")
    b = arrays["bilayer"]
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(12, 10), sharex=True, constrained_layout=True)
    for j, color, label in [(6, "#147d92", "+z: 66"), (7, "#c66b43", "−z: 62")]:
        axs[0].plot(b[:, 0]/1000, b[:, j], c=color, lw=1.5, label=label)
    axs[0].set_ylabel("每脂质投影面积 / nm²" if zh else "Projected area per lipid\n/ nm²"); axs[0].legend(ncol=2)
    axs[1].plot(b[:, 0]/1000, b[:, 8], c="#7566a8", lw=1.5)
    axs[1].set_ylabel("磷酸面间距 / nm" if zh else "Phosphate-plane\nseparation / nm")
    axs[2].plot(b[:, 0]/1000, b[:, 1], c="#147d92", lw=1.5)
    axs[2].set_ylabel("最大取向特征值 S" if zh else "Largest alignment\neigenvalue S")
    axs[2].set_xlabel("半各向同性阶段时间 / ns" if zh else "Semiisotropic-stage time / ns")
    axs[0].set_title("同一片膜，两种叶片分母" if zh else "One membrane area, two leaflet populations")
    for ax in axs: ax.axvspan(15, 30, color="#e8d5ac", alpha=.2); ax.grid(alpha=.15)
    save(fig, args.out/"bilayer-geometry")
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 9), constrained_layout=True)
    centers = (density_edges[:-1]+density_edges[1:])/2
    labels = ["磷酸珠 PO4", "全部尾珠", "水珠 W"] if zh else ["Phosphate beads PO4", "All tail beads", "Water beads W"]
    for values, label, color in zip(density, labels, ["#147d92", "#c59148", "#7896b0"]):
        axs[0].plot(centers, values, label=label, c=color, lw=2)
    axs[0].set(xlabel="距尾端中面的 z / nm" if zh else "z from terminal-tail midplane / nm",
               ylabel="珠数密度 / nm⁻³" if zh else "Bead number density / nm⁻³")
    axs[0].legend(ncol=3, loc="lower center", bbox_to_anchor=(.5, 1.01), fontsize=12)
    positions = np.arange(6)
    axs[1].errorbar(positions, order.mean(axis=0), yerr=order.std(axis=0, ddof=1), fmt="o", c="#147d92", capsize=5)
    axs[1].set_xticks(positions, summary["tail_bond_labels"], rotation=15)
    axs[1].set_ylim(-.5, 1); axs[1].set_ylabel("尾链键取向 P₂" if zh else "Tail-bond orientation P₂")
    axs[1].set_title("误差棒为逐帧均值的标准差" if zh else "Bars show the standard deviation of frame means")
    for ax in axs: ax.grid(alpha=.15)
    save(fig, args.out/"bilayer-profile-order")
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

Read both native TPR/XTC pairs, reconstruct molecular connectivity, and produce bilingual plots and numerical records.

Place assembly.tpr and assembly.xtc in records/assembly, and bilayer.tpr and bilayer.xtc in records/bilayer, then run the analysis command below. The program produces four sets of figures: assembly snapshots, the development of collective orientation, membrane geometry through time, and density with local tail orientation. Language selection changes labels while preserving numerical definitions. All 602 frames across the two stages pass the connectivity checks, and the density integrals agree with the frame-averaged bead counts divided by area. These relationships remain useful when changing the analysis interval or slice thickness because they connect the output directly to counting and units.

### Generate figures in both languages

```
python analyze_lipids.py --assembly records/assembly --bilayer records/bilayer --out analysis-zh --language zh
python analyze_lipids.py --assembly records/assembly --bilayer records/bilayer --out analysis-en --language en
```

The record directories contain assembly.tpr/xtc and bilayer.tpr/xtc respectively; both runs calculate the same numerical values.

The recorded model yields a nearly planar bilayer containing 128 lipids, with 66 in one leaflet and 62 in the other. Over the final 15–30 ns interval of the continuation, its mean projected area is 38.473 nm², phosphate-plane separation is 4.321 nm, and whole-lipid alignment S is about 0.836. Bead-density profiles resolve the water, headgroup, and tail regions. Together, these measurements connect morphology, molecular populations, and internal arrangement. They provide an inspectable starting point for adding polymer chains to the membrane, changing headgroup composition, or studying crowding at a membrane surface.

The meaning of coarse-grained time follows from the retained degrees of freedom. Averaging out rapid internal motions changes friction, energy variations, and some rearrangement pathways, with effects that can differ between processes. Each reported 30 ns stage is an integration-time record. Relating diffusion or assembly rates to a real material requires a process-specific comparison with suitable experiments or a finer-resolution model. Structural comparisons also depend on matched conditions: temperature, hydration, lipid parameter version, leaflet populations, and pressure treatment jointly specify this membrane. Keeping these quantities explicit makes it possible to connect a material modification to a clearly defined scientific question.

A useful next comparison can be small and specific. Keeping lipid chemistry and temperature fixed while adding water would test changes in area, density, and tail orientation. Alternatively, preparing two equally populated leaflets would examine the effect of population asymmetry. These designs change different physical conditions and call for their own replicates and statistical comparisons. The following grafted-polymer example adds flexible chains to a defined membrane surface, extending the question of area per lipid into the number of chains attached per unit area. Resolution, leaflet membership, and the membrane-normal coordinate established here will continue to determine what those new measurements mean.

# 给膜接上聚合物：从稀疏线团到拥挤外衣

Source: https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/
Language: zh-CN

比较两种PEG接枝比例，用真实轨迹理解表面密度、质量分布、末端高度与初始构象的影响。

## 给脂质膜穿上一层会运动的外衣

一根聚乙二醇链在水里可以弯曲、回折、伸展；把它的一端接到脂质上，情况会怎样？脂质的两条疏水尾留在膜中，亲水的聚合物链伸向水，像浮在水面的一个小锚牵着柔软的绳子。许多这样的分子共同组成一层可移动的表面覆盖物。研究者关心覆盖物伸出多远、分布是否均匀、附近的水和其他分子能否进入。这些问题与脂质载体表面设计、界面润湿和生物分子的接近过程有关，也把前面学到的单链构象与膜结构连接在了一起。

“接枝”指链的一端通过化学连接固定在另一种分子或表面上。本节的固定对象是一个脂质分子，因此接枝点仍能随脂质在膜上移动、上下起伏；它没有被钉在空间的一个坐标上。可以把这层表面想成一排系在小浮台上的软绳：浮台之间能交换位置，绳子也各自改变形状。若只看某一时刻的最高端点，会把偶然伸得很长的一条绳子当成整个覆盖层的高度。合理的测量需要同时看链的整体质量分布、末端位置和不同链之间的差异。

接枝稀疏时，一条链身边有较多空间，可以向侧面展开并回到接枝点附近；接枝变密时，相邻链可占据的空间发生重叠，链的构象与周围溶剂共同重新安排。常用的“蘑菇”和“刷子”图像由此而来：前者强调较独立的线团，后者强调密集接枝带来的向外伸展。真正的分子刷始终在热运动中，链与链之间也没有整齐的空隙。把它画成一把笔直的牙刷容易记住名称，却会遗漏链的回折、相互穿插和末端高度分布这些决定测量结果的细节。

本节比较两块含有相同数量脂质锚定分子的平面膜：每块膜共200个，分布在两个叶片，每个叶片100个。其中一种膜有5%的脂质连接PEG，另一种有25%。每条PEG都包含50个EO建模重复单元及一个羟基末端，链的长度保持一致，改变的是接枝分子数量。我们在300 K、1 bar下分别记录20 ns粗粒化动力学，读取每个时刻的膜面积、链质量平均高度、末端高度与回转半径，看看“链更多”究竟如何反映在这些不同指标中。

这两条记录也提供了一个很实际的研究练习：较密的体系从更向外伸展的初始链构象开始，较稀的体系采用自由生长的初始构象，因此分析时需要把密度、初始构象和松弛时间一起考虑。我们会沿着实际曲线判断链在观察窗口中如何变化，把统计窗口固定在后10 ns，并保留各条链的轨迹。这样得到的结果可以直接用于选择后续重复模拟的长度和初始构象，也能帮助判断哪一种“高度”最适合回答具体的表面问题。

## 从脂质载体实验到可以构建的分子外衣

把亲水聚合物接到脂质上的思路，与人们希望改变脂质载体在生物环境中的行为紧密相关。1990年，Klibanov及合作者研究了含有PEG连接脂质的脂质体，比较其在血清中的表现和体内循环过程。脂质体是由脂质双层包围起来的小囊泡，内部和外部都可以有水；改变外表面组成，相当于改变这个小囊泡首先与环境接触的部分。这类实验把一个具体问题推到了前面：表面少量化学修饰，为什么可能改变整个载体的行为？

要沿着这个问题继续深入，就需要观察实验平均值背后的分子安排。2011年，Lee与Pastor利用粗粒化PEG模型研究含PEG脂质的组装结构，联系聚合物参数、组成和不同聚集形态。对本节而言，这段历史最有用的启发是尺度的连接：原子尺度的信息帮助定义链段如何相互作用，较大的粗粒化体系则让更多链和脂质能够一起运动。不同年代模型的映射和参数各有定义，使用今天的Martini 3时，需要按当前实际文件核对化学连接与相互作用。

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/#zh-s2)

图 1 · PEG脂质研究中的三个尺度：载体实验、粗粒化组装与可重复的分子构建。图形为相应科学问题的概念示意。

随着研究对象越来越复杂，构建模型本身成为一个科学步骤。先搭出膜，再给指定脂质连接几十个单元的链，既要保持化学顺序，也要减少严重重叠。2022年介绍的Polyply框架把分子连接关系、参数片段和坐标生长结合起来，使这类结构能够按明确规则生成。我们使用其中PEG化脂质膜的构建方法：INSANE先放置脂质，Polyply补充链，随后由动力学让整个体系松弛。三个步骤各有职责，构建时给出的生长方向只决定起点，后面的运动由力场和运行条件决定。

理解链为什么伸展，可以先从“能有多少种摆法”入手。同一条软绳能够以许多弯曲方式占据接枝点附近的空间；一旦邻居变多，部分摆法因拥挤而变得代价较高。链向水的一侧重新分布，可能减轻拥挤，同时也减少了自由回折的选择。溶剂与链段之间的亲和程度又影响哪种分布更合适。这里的竞争涉及构象熵和相互作用能，单纯把接枝链想成相互推开的刚杆，很难解释为何末端仍会回落到接枝点附近。

科学史在这里串起了三个可操作的问题：实验要求我们关心表面功能，分子模型要求我们说明哪些相互作用被保留，构建工具则要求我们明确如何得到起始结构。下面将这三个问题落实到一对可测量的体系中。膜是平面的周期模型，水和离子参与运动，PEG与脂质有固定的共价连接；蛋白吸附、血液成分与整个载体的循环过程属于更大的研究层次，若研究目标走向这些行为，就需要把相应分子、曲率和观测时间接入模型。

## 认清一个接枝分子：珠子、质量和电荷

本节把PEG连接的脂质分子命名为PEL。它由一个POPE脂质片段、50个EO单元和一个OHter末端组成，共63个粗粒化珠子：脂质片段12个，聚合物部分51个。作为背景膜的另一种脂质是POPC。两个名字中的PC与PE对应不同的极性头部，连接聚合物所需的拓扑由具体的连接参数定义。Polyply命令中的序列直接列出这些片段，因此读懂这行序列就能知道生成的是哪一种分子，而不必根据最终图片猜测化学组成。

珠子名称、珠子类型和化学电荷是三个不同字段。PEL的连接珠名称仍叫NH3，但其实际类型是P5，电荷为零；相邻的PO4珠子类型是Q5，电荷为−1个元电荷，因此整个PEL净电荷为−1。名称保留了拓扑中的识别作用，真正参与静电计算的是电荷列。低接枝体系含10个PEL，需要10个正一价钠离子中和；高接枝体系含50个PEL，需要50个钠离子。把这项计数写清楚，有助于在运行前发现误用未连接脂质电荷的情况。

质量也要从当前模型读取。50个EO珠子每个质量为45 u，末端OH珠子质量为36 u，选入链尺寸分析的51个珠子总质量为2286 u。这里的质量是动力学与质量加权测量使用的模型质量；把所有珠子一律当成相同质量，会让末端获得不同权重。后面计算链的质量中心、质量平均高度和回转半径时，都使用这套实际质量。脂质锚定部分另外承担膜中的连接作用，其12个珠子不加入PEG尺寸的求和范围。

同一套构建流程还指定了一个重要的交叉相互作用：PEG珠子的SN3r类型与磷酸基Q5类型之间，Lennard–Jones参数ε取3.0 kJ/mol，长度参数σ保持0.43 nm。ε控制势阱深度，也影响相应距离上的力；降低ε会减弱该对珠子的吸引井深。这里沿用PEG化膜模型规定的数值，并保留其余参数。本节使用脂质v1文件及与之配套的连接规则，上一节DSPC所用的2025脂质v2属于另一组参数组合，文件替换需要重新检查连接与相互作用的一致性。

PEG与磷酸基的一对非键相互作用式 1

![PEG与磷酸基的一对非键相互作用](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/f54c3700fad433a3ffb76d13.svg)

| 符号 | 含义 | 单位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| U(r) | 距离r处未平移的LJ势能 | kJ/mol |
| r, rₘᵢₙ | 珠子间距离；势阱最低处距离 | nm |
| ε | 该对类型的势阱深度，取3.0 | kJ/mol |
| σLJ | LJ长度参数，取0.43；与接枝密度不同 | nm |
| σLJ/r | 距离的无量纲比 | 1 |
| 4, 2, 6, 12, 1/6 | 常数、幂指数；上标表示乘方 | 1 |
| =, −, /, ( ), [ ] | 相等、相减、相除、先计算括号内容；相邻量相乘 | 1 |

怎样理解短程正项快速上升，较远处的负项产生吸引井；ε改变井深，σLJ定义距离尺度。

算一个例子σLJ=0.43 nm时，最低处r约0.48266 nm，未平移势能为−3.0 kJ/mol。运行输入另在截断处作势能平移。

使用条件此式解释指定类型对的LJ项；完整模型还含静电及成键项，运行采用1.1 nm截断。

下面的程序定位这唯一一行交叉参数，核对长度和原始能量值，再写入规定的ε。若文件已经包含3.0，它会保持现有内容；若读到意外的参数，则报告具体差异，方便检查下载文件的版本。这种小程序把“调整某个相互作用”变成了可检查的具体操作。运行前在基础准备页完成Polyply与INSANE的建模工具安装，再把本节提供的四个Martini参数文件放在工作目录中，后续拓扑生成与动力学就会使用同一组定义。

### 设置PEG与磷酸基交叉参数

```
"""Apply the PEG–phosphate interaction specified by the Polyply tutorial.

The Q5–SN3r Lennard-Jones epsilon becomes 3.0 kJ/mol; sigma stays 0.43 nm.
Running this on an already corrected file leaves its bytes unchanged.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import math

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("file", nargs="?", type=Path, default=Path("martini_v3.0.0.itp"))
    args = parser.parse_args(); lines = args.file.read_text().splitlines()
    matches = []
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        fields = line.split(";")[0].split()
        if len(fields) == 5 and set(fields[:2]) == {"Q5", "SN3r"}:
            matches.append((index, fields))
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected exactly one Q5–SN3r pair entry")
    index, fields = matches[0]
    if not math.isclose(float(fields[3]), .43, abs_tol=1e-10):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected pair sigma")
    old = float(fields[4])
    if math.isclose(old, 3.0, abs_tol=1e-10):
        print("Q5–SN3r already uses epsilon 3.0 kJ/mol and sigma 0.43 nm")
    elif math.isclose(old, 4.175, abs_tol=1e-10):
        lines[index] = " ".join([*fields[:4], "3.0"])+" ; PEG-phosphate correction prescribed by original Polyply tutorial"
        args.file.write_text("\n".join(lines)+"\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        print("Q5–SN3r epsilon: 4.175 -> 3.0 kJ/mol; sigma retained at 0.43 nm")
    else:
        raise ValueError("Pair parameters differ from both defined input states")
```

核对唯一类型对与原参数，应用规定的ε值。

运行时还会同时出现成键参数和非键参数。前者规定PEG内部相邻珠子如何连接、键角如何改变以及连接脂质时采用哪种局部几何；后者规定没有直接化学连接的珠子怎样相互吸引或排斥。链能够保持连续，主要依靠拓扑中的成键项，而它愿意靠近水、磷酸基还是其他链段，又取决于相应的非键项。改变某一对非键参数不会自动重新生成链的连接关系，因此检查时要分别确认“接对了”和“相互作用选对了”这两层问题。

## 把链接到正确的脂质上

构建从一块8 nm×8 nm的膜开始。INSANE按输入的相对组成放置POPC和POPE，实际得到每个叶片100个脂质；低比例每叶片有95个POPC和5个POPE，高比例则是75个与25个。随后POPE会成为PEL的锚定部分，Polyply从它的连接珠向外补齐PEG。坐标文件中的分子排列与拓扑的分子排列必须一致，因为GROMACS按顺序把坐标赋给拓扑中的原子。数目正确但顺序错位，也会把本该属于PEG的参数分配给别的坐标。

下面的程序逐个读取脂质，保存真实排列，按连续出现的分子种类写出拓扑计数。它还利用头部坐标判断每个锚位于哪一叶片，为高接枝构建指定向水侧生长的方向。每条生长约束都指向正确的系统分子编号，因此即使POPC和PEL交替排列，也能找到对应链。当前盒子是正交盒，九数形式中六个非对角项都为零，程序将其写成等价的三个边长，便于坐标生成工具读取；膜的位置和盒子大小在这个表示转换中保持一致。

### 按坐标顺序建立分子拓扑

```
from pathlib import Path
from itertools import groupby
from collections import Counter
import json
lines=Path('bilayer.gro').read_text().splitlines();n=int(lines[1]);atoms=lines[2:2+n]
box=[float(v) for v in lines[-1].split()]
if len(box)==9:
    assert all(abs(v)<1e-12 for v in box[3:]),'This construction uses an orthorhombic box'
    lines[-1]=' '.join(f'{v:10.5f}' for v in box[:3]);Path('bilayer.gro').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
groups=[list(v) for _,v in groupby(atoms,key=lambda l:l[:10])]
assert all(len(g)==12 for g in groups)
phosphates=[float(l[36:44]) for l in atoms if l[10:15].strip()=='PO4'];mid=sum(phosphates)/len(phosphates)
species=[];report=[];build=[]
for i,g in enumerate(groups):
    name=g[0][5:10].strip();assert name in ['POPC','POPE'];species.append('PEL' if name=='POPE' else name)
    head=next(l for l in g if l[10:15].strip() in ['NC3','NH3']);z=float(head[36:44]);side=1 if z>mid else -1
    report.append(dict(index=i,original=name,molecule=species[-1],head_z_nm=z,leaflet=side))
    if name=='POPE':build.append(f'[ molecule ]\nPEL {i} {i+1}\n[ rw_restriction ]\nEO 0 100 0 0 {side} 90\n')
top=''.join(f'#include "{s}"\n' for s in ['martini_v3.0.0.itp','martini_v3.0.0_ions_v1.itp','martini_v3.0.0_solvents_v1.itp','martini_v3.0.0_phospholipids_v1.itp','PEL.itp'])
top+='[ system ]\nPEGylated membrane\n[ molecules ]\n'
top+=''.join(f'{name} {len(list(g))}\n' for name,g in groupby(species))
Path('system.top').write_text(top);Path('growth.bld').write_text('\n'.join(build))
Path('bilayer-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(lipids=len(groups),molecules=dict(Counter(species)),midplane_nm=mid,leaflet_counts={str(side):dict(Counter(r['molecule'] for r in report if r['leaflet']==side)) for side in [-1,1]},molecule_order=report),indent=2))
```

逐分子核对组成、叶片与高比例生长范围。

低接枝比例使用自由随机生长，高比例使用朝外半空间中的随机生长，以减少初始链之间严重穿插和堆叠。可以把这一步理解为给一团软线选择合理的起始摆法：摆法会影响最初的松弛过程，却不会在后续动力学中持续命令链朝某个方向移动。高接枝盒子在法向取33 nm，低接枝取20 nm，为初始链和水层留出空间。两步建模都使用各自同一个盒高，使膜中面与后续水层定位保持一致。

随机种子使一次构建中的抽样序列明确。下面的短程序在调用Polyply前设置Python和NumPy的随机状态；完整构建脚本分别使用固定的INSANE种子和链生长种子，并将参数生成、膜生成、分子顺序检查和链生长串起来。种子解决的是同一实现中的随机选择，软件版本、参数库和输入结构也共同决定生成过程。阅读脚本时可以沿着文件流追踪：脂质参数先生成PEL拓扑，脂质坐标随后补成带链坐标，最后写出动力学所需的运行设置。

### 固定坐标生长随机状态

```
import random,sys,runpy,shutil
import numpy as np
seed=int(sys.argv[1]);random.seed(seed);np.random.seed(seed)
entry=shutil.which('polyply');assert entry
sys.argv=[entry,*sys.argv[2:]];runpy.run_path(entry,run_name='__main__')
```

设置Python与NumPy种子后调用Polyply。

### 从脂质片段生成完整带链膜

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
fraction=${1:-5}
case "$fraction" in
  5) height=20; other=95; growth=() ;;
  25) height=33; other=75; growth=(-b growth.bld) ;;
  *) echo "Choose 5 or 25 percent PEL" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
export INSANE_SEED=$((20261600 + fraction))
python patch_interaction.py
polyply gen_params -f martini_v3.0.0_phospholipids_v1.itp -lib martini3 -o PEL.itp -name PEL -seq POPE:1 EO:50 OHter:1 > topology-generation.log 2>&1
insane -l "POPC:$other" -l "POPE:$fraction" -o bilayer.gro -dz "$height" -x 8 -y 8 -pbc rectangular > insane.log 2>&1
python build_topology.py
python seeded_polyply.py "$((20261650 + fraction))" gen_coords -p system.top -o polymer-bilayer.gro -res EO OHter -c bilayer.gro -name PEGylated -box 8 8 "$height" -split POPE:HEAD-NH3:TAIL-PO4,GL1,GL2,C1A,D2A,C3A,C4A,C1B,C2B,C3B,C4B "${growth[@]}" > coordinate-generation.log 2>&1
python write_parameters.py --fraction "$fraction"
```

传入5或25，分别构建低比例与高比例；先完成基础准备页的建模工具安装。

构建命令中的split选项尤其值得读一次。它将连接珠与脂质其余部分分开标识，让新链能够从正确的连接位置开始生成，同时保留已有脂质的空间结构。它没有切断最终拓扑中的化学连接。类似地，res选项告诉程序哪些残基需要补坐标，已经放置好的脂质仍作为建模参照。将这些选项与生成文件中的63个珠子逐一对应，就能看清一条看似很长的命令如何分别处理“已有部分”“新添部分”和“二者的接点”。

本节参考包同时包含已经构建好的两组带链膜，可以从它们直接进入溶剂化步骤。若从头重建，请在两个分别存放公共脚本和参数的目录中运行构建脚本，参数分别传入5与25；若从提供的结构继续，则将对应fraction目录中的带链坐标、系统拓扑和叶片审计文件复制到各自工作目录。两条路径使用相同的化学模型。比较轨迹时保留所选择的初始结构，尤其要记录高比例的朝外生长条件，因为后面的高度曲线会清楚显示这一条件留下的松弛过程。

## 让水、离子、链和膜一起松弛

把水盒叠加到带链膜周围时，几何填充工具可能在疏水尾部核心留下少量水珠。这个区域最初应由脂质尾占据，因此我们以初始膜中面为中心，去掉法向距离小于1.5 nm的水珠，再按保留数量更新拓扑。程序只改变水的初始放置，脂质与PEG的坐标保持原样。这个1.5 nm是本例构建的核心排水半厚度，与随后从轨迹测得的聚合物高度属于不同定义；它也没有作为生产阶段的外加排斥墙存在。

### 清理初始膜核心的水珠

```
from pathlib import Path
import json
lines=Path('water-added.gro').read_text().splitlines();n=int(lines[1]);atoms=lines[2:2+n];box=[float(x) for x in lines[-1].split()]
mid=json.loads(Path('bilayer-audit.json').read_text())['midplane_nm']
kept=[];removed=0;water=0
for l in atoms:
    iswater=l[5:10].strip()=='W'
    dz=float(l[36:44])-mid;dz-=box[2]*round(dz/box[2])
    if iswater and abs(dz)<1.5:removed+=1;continue
    if iswater:water+=1
    kept.append(l[:15]+f'{(len(kept)+1)%100000:5d}'+l[20:])
Path('solvated.gro').write_text('PEGylated membrane with tail core excluded from water placement\n'+f'{len(kept):5d}\n'+'\n'.join(kept)+'\n'+lines[-1]+'\n')
Path('topol.top').write_text(Path('system.top').read_text()+f'W {water}\n')
Path('solvation-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(water_beads_before=water+removed,water_beads_after=water,removed_tail_core_beads=removed,excluded_half_thickness_nm=1.5,midplane_nm=mid),indent=2))
```

按初始中面排除1.5 nm半厚度内的W珠，并更新数量。

完成排水和电荷中和后，5%体系包含10575个珠子：190个POPC、10个PEL、7655个水珠和10个钠离子；25%体系包含16198个珠子：150个POPC、50个PEL、11198个水珠和50个钠离子。水珠采用当前Martini水模型，一颗W珠汇总多个水分子的行为。两体系水层高度不同，水珠数量也随之不同。我们把比较对象放在每条链和每叶片面积上，计算时逐项归一化，从而使单纯的链数量或总盒体积不会直接放大所画出的高度分布。

初始链段之间可能存在较近接触，因此先最小化，再逐渐增大动力学步长。本例依次运行20 ps的2 fs步长准备、100 ps的5 fs步长松弛、2 ns的20 fs步长准备，最后记录20 ns。能量最小化寻找附近较低势能的构型，动力学准备让速度、溶剂和链构象一起调整。步长增大依赖本例粗粒化势的时间尺度和实际运行稳定性；把同样数值直接用于含原子级快速振动的体系，会改变数值积分的适用条件。

所有动力学阶段采用300 K温控和1 bar半各向同性压力耦合，横向两个方向共同调整，法向可以分别响应。静电采用介电常数15的反应场处理，实空间截断为1.1 nm，邻居表范围1.35 nm；这组条件应与Martini参数一起阅读。每个阶段的完整设置由下面的程序写出，温压耦合状态通过检查点连续传入下一阶段。生产段保存201个结构帧，时间从0到20 ns、间隔0.1 ns，足够观察这次记录中的慢变化和链间差异。

### 写出每个动力学阶段的完整设置

```
"""Write full MDP inputs for the 5 or 25 percent PEL membrane."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse

EM = """integrator = steep
nsteps = 10000
nstxout = 0
nstvout = 0
nstfout = 0
cutoff-scheme = Verlet
nstlist = 20
nsttcouple = 20
nstpcouple = 20
rlist = 1.35
verlet-buffer-tolerance = -1
pbc = xyz
coulombtype = reaction-field
rcoulomb = 1.1
epsilon-r = 15
epsilon-rf = 0
vdw-type = cutoff
vdw-modifier = Potential-shift-verlet
rvdw = 1.1
constraints = none
constraint-algorithm = Lincs
lincs-order = 8
lincs-warnangle = 90
lincs-iter = 2
emtol = 100
emstep = 0.01
"""

BASE = """integrator = md
dt = 0.02
nsteps = 1000000
comm-mode = Linear
nstcomm = 100
comm-grps = System
nstxout = 0
nstvout = 0
nstfout = 0
nstlog = 10000
nstenergy = 500
nstxout-compressed = 5000
compressed-x-precision = 100
compressed-x-grps = 
energygrps = System
cutoff-scheme = Verlet
nstlist = 20
nsttcouple = 20
nstpcouple = 5
rlist = 1.35
verlet-buffer-tolerance = -1
pbc = xyz
coulombtype = reaction-field
rcoulomb = 1.1
epsilon-r = 15
epsilon-rf = 0
vdw-type = cutoff
vdw-modifier = Potential-shift-verlet
rvdw = 1.1
tcoupl = v-rescale
tc-grps = System
tau-t = 1.0
ref-t = 300
gen-vel = no
gen-temp = 300
gen-seed = 20261625
pcoupl = c-rescale
pcoupltype = semiisotropic
tau-p = 4.0
ref-p = 1 1
compressibility = 3e-4 3e-4
constraints = none
constraint-algorithm = Lincs
lincs-order = 8
lincs-warnangle = 90
lincs-iter = 2
ld-seed = 20261658
continuation = yes
"""

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--fraction", type=int, choices=[5, 25], required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("."))
    args = parser.parse_args(); args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    values = dict(line.split(" = ", 1) for line in BASE.splitlines())
    (args.out/"em.mdp").write_text(EM, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    stages = [("preflight", ".002", 10000), ("relax", ".005", 20000),
              ("equil", ".02", 100000), ("md", ".02", 1000000)]
    for index, (stage, dt, steps) in enumerate(stages):
        parameters = dict(values)
        parameters.update(dt=str(float(dt)), nsteps=str(steps))
        parameters["gen-vel"] = "yes" if index == 0 else "no"
        parameters["gen-seed"] = str(20261620+args.fraction)
        parameters["ld-seed"] = str(20261650+args.fraction+index)
        parameters["continuation"] = "no" if index == 0 else "yes"
        content = "".join(f"{key} = {value}\n" for key, value in parameters.items())
        (args.out/f"{stage}.mdp").write_text(content, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print("Wrote em, preflight, relax, equil, and md parameter files")
```

--fraction 5或25写出与对应实际运行一致的五份MDP。

### 溶剂化、中和、松弛与记录

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
gmx=${GMX:-gmx}
python=${PYTHON:-python3}
"$gmx" solvate -cp polymer-bilayer.gro -cs water.gro -radius 0.21 -o water-added.gro > solvate.log 2>&1
"$python" clean_water.py
"$gmx" grompp -f em.mdp -c solvated.gro -p topol.top -o ions.tpr > ions.grompp.log 2>&1
printf 'W\n' | "$gmx" genion -s ions.tpr -o ions.gro -p topol.top -pname NA -nname CL -neutral -seed 20261601 > genion.log 2>&1
"$gmx" grompp -f em.mdp -c ions.gro -p topol.top -o em.tpr > em.grompp.log 2>&1
"$gmx" mdrun -deffnm em -ntmpi 1 -ntomp 2 -pin off > em.stdout.log 2>&1
"$gmx" grompp -f preflight.mdp -c em.gro -p topol.top -o preflight.tpr > preflight.grompp.log 2>&1
"$gmx" mdrun -deffnm preflight -ntmpi 1 -ntomp 2 -pin off > preflight.stdout.log 2>&1
prev=preflight
for stage in relax equil md; do
  "$gmx" grompp -f "$stage.mdp" -c "$prev.gro" -t "$prev.cpt" -p topol.top -o "$stage.tpr" > "$stage.grompp.log" 2>&1
  "$gmx" mdrun -deffnm "$stage" -ntmpi 1 -ntomp 2 -pin off > "$stage.stdout.log" 2>&1
  prev=$stage
done
printf 'Temperature\nPotential\nPressure\nVolume\nDensity\nBox-X\nBox-Y\nBox-Z\n0\n' | "$gmx" energy -f md.edr -o md-properties.xvg > energy.log 2>&1
"$gmx" check -f md.xtc > trajectory-check.log 2>&1
```

从带链膜坐标与系统拓扑开始，逐阶段传递检查点。

### 从提供的带链膜启动一次完整计算

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

case "$fraction" in 5|25) ;; *) echo "Choose 5 or 25" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

```

在参考包examples目录中运行bash start.sh 5或bash start.sh 25，各自复制输入到work子目录后运行。

脚本把每一阶段的输出作为下一阶段的输入：坐标文件保存当时的位置，检查点还携带速度与需要延续的运行状态，新的MDP文件则定义接下来如何推进。生产时间重新从零计起，表示图中0 ns之前已经完成准备阶段。读到图中的20 ns时，应该把它理解为记录段的长度。保存间隔与积分步长也相差很大：积分每20 fs更新一次，而图片分析每100 ps读取一帧，前者决定数值推进，后者决定能够回看哪些运动细节。

观察生产段的起点，可以预先知道后面应留意什么：低比例体系的PEG质量平均高度约0.96 nm，末端平均高度约1.50 nm；高比例对应约3.58 nm与6.20 nm。两组起点相差明显，高比例中不少链仍很伸展。后面的轨迹将显示低比例链逐渐向外展开，而高比例链部分回缩。把这两条演化放在一起读，比只比较最后两个数更能说明初始构象的作用，也为后续采用多种起始摆法和独立重复提供直接依据。

## 接枝比例相同，表面拥挤程度也可能不同

配方中的5%或25%表示脂质锚定分子中有多少比例携带PEG。真正描述表面上链有多密的量，则是一个叶片中的接枝链数除以该叶片占据的膜投影面积。两片叶片面向相反的水层，因此算上侧的链密度时，用上侧的链数和膜横向面积；把两侧链数全部除以一次面积，会使结果多出一倍。压力耦合又会让面积随时间变化，所以同一组固定链数也有随时间变化的接枝密度。

组成比例与每叶片接枝密度式 2

![组成比例与每叶片接枝密度](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/1b44044187c226f60392eb3c.svg)

| 符号 | 含义 | 单位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| f | 携带PEG的脂质分子比例 | 1 |
| NPEL, NPOPC | 所计表面或整个体系中的两类分子数，范围一致 | 1 |
| N g | 一个叶片中的接枝链数，5或25 | 1 |
| t | 观察时刻 | ns |
| Lₓ, Lᵧ | 正交膜盒的两个横向边长 | nm |
| A | 一片叶片的横向投影面积 | nm² |
| Γ | 每叶片每面积的接枝链数 | nm⁻² |
| =, +, /, ( ) | 相等、相加、相除；括号标明时刻；相邻边长相乘 | 1 |

怎样理解比例计数没有长度信息；每面积链数把配方与实际膜几何连接起来。

算一个例子每叶片5条链、100个脂质时f=0.05。面积65 nm²时，Γ=5/65=0.076923 nm⁻²。

使用条件平面正交盒中的投影密度；两叶片分别计数。报告均值时先逐帧计算Γ。

在后10 ns，低比例膜的平均投影面积约65.358 nm²，每叶片有5条链，逐帧计算后得到平均接枝密度0.07651 nm⁻²；高比例膜面积约68.738 nm²，每叶片25条链，平均密度0.36374 nm⁻²。高比例的链数增加5倍，实际密度增加约4.75倍，因为膜面积也不同。对逐帧密度求平均，与把链数除以平均面积在数学上略有差别；这里报告前一种定义，使每个时刻的几何条件都参与同样的计算。

### 膜面积与接枝密度

两体系逐帧投影面积与每叶片接枝密度；淡色背景标后10 ns。

Martini 3脂质v1与Polyply PEG50模型；每片膜200个脂质，PEL比例5%或25%，每叶片分别5或25条PEG链。300 K、1 bar，各采样20 ns；保留不同水盒、Na⁺数量及构建起点。Q5–SN3r采用原教程规定的ε=3.0 kJ/mol。

[下载参考数据与完整输入（ZIP） 21.26 MB](https://github.com/GellmanSparrowS/ml-biomat-blog/releases/download/md-courses-2026-11/gromacs-pegmembrane-comparison-reference-data.zip)

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/#zh-s6)

两体系各201帧的膜投影面积与每叶片接枝密度，淡色背景标出后10 ns的101帧；面密度用每叶片实际接枝数除以该帧膜面积。

面积倒数还能给出一个容易理解的长度尺度：先求每条链平均可分到的面积，再取平方根，得到特征间距。按上述密度估算，低比例约3.62 nm，高比例约1.66 nm。这个长度类似把不规则分布的接枝点均匀分到方格后得到的格距，实际最近邻距离还取决于位置分布和脂质的横向运动。它的用途是把“每平方纳米多少条链”转成可与链尺寸比较的尺度，让密度从抽象的数字变成空间上的问题。

从表面密度估算间距与重叠尺度式 3

![从表面密度估算间距与重叠尺度](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/fa011b4207454444bd4093ca.svg)

| 符号 | 含义 | 单位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| d | 平均每链面积的平方根，特征间距 | nm |
| Γ | 每叶片接枝密度 | nm⁻² |
| R₀ | 独立给定的参考线团足迹半径 | nm |
| π | 圆周率，约3.14159 | 1 |
| R₀², πR₀² | 半径平方；圆形参考足迹面积 | nm² |
| χ | 圆形参考足迹面积与每链面积之比 | 1 |
| −1/2, ², = | 负二分之一次幂表示倒数开方；平方与相等；相邻量相乘 | 1 |

怎样理解每链面积是1/Γ，取平方根得到长度；乘以参考足迹面积得到无量纲重叠指标。

算一个例子Γ=0.25 nm⁻²、R₀=1 nm时，d=2 nm，χ=π/4≈0.7854。

使用条件均匀分配面积与圆形足迹的几何估计；实际最近邻距离和构象转变需分子轨迹。

[Figure: 参考圆形足迹与每链面积](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/#zh-s6)

均匀接枝位置与圆形线团足迹的几何算例；显示相邻九个面积单元，输入链数用于计算整个叶片的密度。

交互图用一个指定的参考线团半径，在平面上画出相应的圆形足迹，再与接枝点平均分配的面积比较。圆形足迹面积与每链面积之比越大，说明参考线团之间越容易发生空间重叠。参考半径是这个几何算例的输入，应由单独的稀溶液或稀接枝测量来确定；后面测得的密接枝链回转半径已经受到环境影响，不能不加区分地拿来定义自由线团。圆相互重叠表示几何尺度的交叠，分子仍然是有回折、有水穿入的柔性链。

密度的解释也要回到膜的可移动性。在固体表面，接枝位点可能固定在材料结构中；在这里，携带PEG的脂质可以在叶片内移动，邻居关系会随时间改变。高比例体系除了平均密度较高，还可能有局部密度涨落，PEG与头部之间的相互作用又会影响这些局部安排。若研究重点变成聚集或均匀覆盖，可以继续对接枝点做二维距离与空间分布分析，并同时观察膜面积，这样就能把平均拥挤程度与局部组织区分开来。

## 一条链有不止一种高度

测量链向外伸出多远，首先要为每条链选一个随它一起移动的零点。本节用该PEL的NH3连接珠作为零点，取膜法向的坐标差；上叶片向上为正，下叶片向下为正。这样两侧伸向水的链都具有正的向外高度，膜整体平移也不会改变结果。坐标求差前，程序沿拓扑中的每条键恢复完整分子，并检查所有键长，避免跨周期边界的同一条链被读成两个相距一个盒高的片段。

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/#zh-s7)

图 2 · 两叶片分别取朝向水的方向为正，每条链都相对自身NH3连接珠测量。示意链形与膜厚用于解释坐标定义。

相对连接珠的向外高度式 4

![相对连接珠的向外高度](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/8538bee70d1ed2fd988fd96c.svg)

| 符号 | 含义 | 单位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| c, i, 0, 51 | 链序号、PEG珠子序号；0为NH3连接珠，51为OH末端 | 1 |
| s c | 上叶片+1，下叶片−1，令向水侧为正 | 1 |
| zci, zc0 | 完整分子表示中PEG珠子和连接珠的法向坐标 | nm |
| hci, Hc, Hc,end | 单珠高度、链质量平均高度、末端高度 | nm |
| mi, M | 珠子质量；51个PEG珠子的总质量2286 | u |
| mi hci | 质量与高度的乘积 | u nm |
| Σ, =, −, /, ( ) | 对51个PEG珠子求和、相等、相减、相除、括号；相邻量相乘 | 1 |

怎样理解减去各自连接点消除整体平移，叶片符号统一外侧方向，质量权重描述聚合物质量的位置。

算一个例子下叶片连接珠z=10 nm、末端z=7 nm，s=−1，末端向外高度为3 nm。

使用条件先按键图恢复完整PEL；仅51个PEG珠子进入质量平均，连接珠用作零点。

把51个PEG珠子的高度按质量加权，得到一条链的质量平均高度；只取末端OH珠子的高度，得到末端高度；再围绕PEG自己的三维质量中心计算回转半径，得到链整体铺开的尺度。这三种测量回答不同问题。若链沿膜面摊开，回转半径可以较大，质量平均高度却较小；若只有末端的一小段伸得很高，末端高度的变化会比整条链的质量平均高度更明显。一个单独的“链高”名称不足以说明测量过程，必须把选入珠子、参考点和平均方式写清楚。

PEG自身的三维回转半径式 5

![PEG自身的三维回转半径](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/ef2f5f340c0fad7378b4f475.svg)

| 符号 | 含义 | 单位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| c, i, 51 | 链编号、PEG珠子编号、所选珠子总数 | 1 |
| rci, rc,cm | PEG珠子位置向量与PEG质量中心 | nm |
| mi, M | 当前珠子质量与所选PEG总质量 | u |
| Rg,c | 此链PEG部分的回转半径 | nm |
| ‖rci−rc,cm‖² | 到质量中心的距离平方 | nm² |
| mi‖rci−rc,cm‖² | 质量乘距离平方 | u nm² |
| Σ, √, =, −, /, 1 | 求和、平方根、相等、向量相减、相除、常数1；相邻量相乘 | 1 |

怎样理解质量中心随整条PEG移动，距离平方平均描述所有方向上的展开程度。

算一个例子几何算例中两个等质量点相距2 nm，中心在中间，每点距中心1 nm，因此Rg=1 nm。

使用条件本例仅PEG的51珠，使用原生质量与完整分子坐标；逐链先开方，再平均Rg。

### 三种链尺寸的真实演化

每帧先逐链测量，再对该体系全部链平均。

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/#zh-s7)

以各链NH3接枝点为高度零点，分别观察质量平均高度、末端高度与PEG回转半径；方向按各自叶片的外法线统一。

在后10 ns，低比例体系的PEG质量平均高度为1.717 nm，高比例为3.031 nm；末端平均高度分别为2.356 nm与4.630 nm；PEG回转半径分别为1.782 nm与2.082 nm。高比例链的质量和末端都分布在更远的外侧，而回转半径的增加幅度较小。这很合理：把一团链重新沿法向分配，并不要求它的全部三维尺寸按同样比例增大。曲线还显示高比例链在记录早期明显回缩，后段仍有变化，比较时应保留这段20 ns观察范围。

平均值旁边还藏着另一层结构：同一时刻，不同链的末端高度差别很大。对每帧的所有链计算末端高度总体标准差，再在后10 ns平均，低比例为约1.739 nm，高比例为约2.156 nm。这里的标准差描述一帧内链与链的分散程度，使用全部链数量作为分母；时间曲线本身的波动则是逐帧链均值的变化，分析表对这些帧值采用样本标准差。高比例体系有更多链参与平均，平均曲线较平稳，同时仍保留很宽的单链分布，这两件事可以同时发生。

### 每条链的末端高度

链号从零开始，使用同一颜色尺度显示两体系全部201帧。

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/#zh-s7)

全部20 ns内每条链的末端向外高度，两个体系采用共同色标；纵轴为实际链编号。同一体系中的链和保存帧共享环境，两种条件则保留各自起始构象、盒高与溶剂组成。

热图把每条链沿时间的末端高度放在单独一行，行号是从零开始的固定链序号。连续的亮带表示某条链在一段时间内保持较高末端，暗带表示它更多停留在接枝点附近；两种颜色之间的过渡显示回折与展开。横向逐行阅读可以看到单链记忆，纵向阅读可以比较同一时刻的链间差异。出现少量负高度时，含义是末端位于它自己的连接珠内侧；是否真正穿过膜，需要结合完整膜几何和整条链的位置另行判断。

## 把分布、完整代码和研究问题连起来

为了看清聚合物覆盖层占据哪些高度，可以把法向分成等宽的小格，统计每个格子中的PEG质量。每条链先除以自身的总质量，所有链再按相同权重平均，最后除以高度格宽。得到的曲线纵轴单位为nm⁻¹，曲线下面积为1，因此两组不同链数的结果可以直接比较形状。若把它乘以实际接枝密度和每链质量，就能进一步构造单位面积上的质量分布；本节先使用归一化概率密度，专门观察每条链的质量如何沿法向分配。

按每条链归一化的高度概率密度式 6

![按每条链归一化的高度概率密度](https://ml-biomat.com/static/agent-math/e3165ee4f76890f8f053f0fb.svg)

| 符号 | 含义 | 单位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| p k | 第k个高度格的质量加权概率密度 | nm⁻¹ |
| k, f, c, i | 高度格、帧、链、PEG珠子索引 | 1 |
| F, Nc, 51 | 帧数101、链数10或50、每链PEG珠子数 | 1 |
| Δh, hfci | 格宽0.25与该珠子向外高度 | nm |
| mi/M | 该珠子占其PEG链总质量的比例 | 1 |
| Bk | 第k格的高度区间 | 区间单位nm |
| 𝕀 | 条件成立取1，否则取0 | 1 |
| Σ, =, /, Δ, ∈, 1 | 求和、相等、相除、区间宽度记号、属于区间、常数1；相邻量相乘 | 1 |

怎样理解每条链质量权重总和为1，再平均所有链与帧并除以格宽，得到可跨链数比较的分布。

算一个例子若宽0.25 nm的一格包含总归一化权重0.10，该格密度为0.10/0.25=0.40 nm⁻¹。

使用条件后10 ns的101帧，格子覆盖全部选定样本；末端分布对每链末端等权计数。

### 质量与末端高度分布

后10 ns的101帧，质量分布每链归一化；末端分布每条链等权。

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/#zh-s8)

后10 ns的两种高度分布：上图按每条PEG链的模型质量归一化，统计各珠相对接枝点的高度；下图统计每条链的末端高度。两体系各用共同分格，密度积分均为1。

低比例的质量分布较集中在靠近接枝点的区域，高比例在更远的高度仍有明显权重，反映向水侧展开的覆盖层。末端高度分布则更宽，因为一个末端的位置可以随局部回折快速改变，它也不代表整条链的质量都移到了那里。图中两种分布均按后10 ns的101帧统计，高度格包含该窗口中的全部样本。概率密度较高表示落入单位高度范围的权重较多，曲线的峰值本身可以因格宽改变，因此比较时两组使用统一的格子和归一化方式。

[Figure: diagram](https://ml-biomat.com/tutorials/molecular-dynamics/g16/#zh-s8)

图 3 · 三个珠子的质量归一化算例：45、45、36 u各进入一个1 nm高度格。实际PEG含51珠，分析还平均全部链与帧。

下面的完整分析程序读取拓扑中的质量、分子边界和键图，逐帧还原每个PEL，核对两叶片的链数、分子电荷与最大键长，再计算所有指标。它把链级记录、逐帧平均值和汇总表分别输出，便于从一幅总体曲线追查到具体链。内部坐标由MDAnalysis按Å读取，输出时显式换算为nm；时间由ps换算为ns。链号、统计窗口和单位都与图中标注一致，修改选取范围时也能沿着相同程序重新生成结果。

### 完整的双体系链级分析

```
"""Measure PEG50 chains on two recorded lipid membranes.

python analyze_brush.py --low records/5 --high records/25 --out analysis --language en
Each record directory contains md.tpr and md.xtc. Dependencies: MDAnalysis,
NumPy, Matplotlib. Lengths read by MDAnalysis are in angstrom.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import csv
import json
import numpy as np
import MDAnalysis as mda
from MDAnalysis.lib.distances import minimize_vectors
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager


def connection_plan(group):
    local = {int(v): i for i, v in enumerate(group.indices)}
    edges = np.array([[local[int(a)], local[int(b)]] for a, b in group.bonds.indices])
    graph = [[] for _ in group]
    for k, (a, b) in enumerate(edges):
        graph[a].append((b, k, 1)); graph[b].append((a, k, -1))
    queue, seen, plan = [0], {0}, []
    for a in queue:
        for b, k, sign in graph[a]:
            if b not in seen:
                queue.append(b); seen.add(b); plan.append((a, b, k, sign))
    if len(seen) != len(group):
        raise ValueError("A PEL molecule must have one connected bond graph")
    return edges, plan


def reconstruct(raw, box, edges, plan):
    delta = minimize_vectors(raw[edges[:, 1]]-raw[edges[:, 0]], box)
    whole = np.empty_like(raw, dtype=float); whole[0] = raw[0]
    for a, b, k, sign in plan:
        whole[b] = whole[a]+sign*delta[k]
    observed = whole[edges[:, 1]]-whole[edges[:, 0]]
    if np.max(np.linalg.norm(observed-delta, axis=1)) > .005:
        raise ValueError("A reconstructed bond cycle does not close")
    longest = float(np.linalg.norm(observed, axis=1).max()/10)
    if longest > .7:
        raise ValueError("A coarse-grained PEL bond exceeds 0.7 nm")
    return whole/10, longest


def stats(a):
    return {"mean": float(np.mean(a)), "sd": float(np.std(a, ddof=1)),
            "minimum": float(np.min(a)), "maximum": float(np.max(a))}


def save(fig, path):
    fig.savefig(path.with_suffix(".svg")); fig.savefig(path.with_suffix(".png"), dpi=150)
    plt.close(fig)


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--low", type=Path, default=Path("records/5"))
    p.add_argument("--high", type=Path, default=Path("records/25"))
    p.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("analysis"))
    p.add_argument("--language", choices=["zh", "en"], default="en")
    args = p.parse_args(); args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    zh = args.language == "zh"
    present = {f.name for f in font_manager.fontManager.ttflist}
    fonts = ["Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC",
             "WenQuanYi Zen Hei", "DejaVu Sans"] if zh else ["DejaVu Sans"]
    plt.rcParams.update({"font.family": [f for f in fonts if f in present],
                         "font.size": 14, "axes.labelsize": 15,
                         "svg.fonttype": "path", "axes.unicode_minus": False,
                         "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
    summaries = []; all_arrays = []; all_chains = []; all_heights = []; snapshots = []
    for fraction, folder, count, waters, atoms in [(5, args.low, 10, 7655, 10575),
                                                 (25, args.high, 50, 11198, 16198)]:
        u = mda.Universe(str(folder/"md.tpr"), str(folder/"md.xtc"))
        pel = u.select_atoms("moltype PEL")
        chains = [pel[pel.molnums == number] for number in np.unique(pel.molnums)]
        if len(chains) != count or len(u.atoms) != atoms or len(u.select_atoms("moltype W")) != waters:
            raise ValueError("Composition differs from the selected recorded model")
        if len(u.select_atoms("moltype NA")) != count or abs(sum(u.atoms.charges)) > 1e-5:
            raise ValueError("Counterion count or total charge differs from the model")
        for chain in chains:
            if len(chain) != 63 or list(chain.names[:2]) != ["NH3", "PO4"]:
                raise ValueError("Expected a 63-bead PEL with NH3 and PO4 first")
            if list(chain.resnames[12:]) != ["EO"]*50+["OHter"]:
                raise ValueError("Expected 50 EO beads followed by one OHter bead")
            if abs(sum(chain.charges)+1) > 1e-5 or not np.allclose(chain.masses[12:], [45]*50+[36]):
                raise ValueError("PEL charge or PEG bead masses differ from the model")
        plans = [connection_plan(c) for c in chains]
        records = []; individual = []; height_frames = []; initial_sides = None
        changes = 0; max_bond = 0.; final_shapes = []
        for frame in u.trajectory:
            if not np.allclose(frame.dimensions[3:], 90):
                raise ValueError("The recorded box must be orthorhombic")
            area = float(frame.dimensions[0])*float(frame.dimensions[1])/100
            rows = []; heights = []; sides = []; shapes = []
            for index, (chain, (edges, plan)) in enumerate(zip(chains, plans)):
                xyz, longest = reconstruct(chain.positions.astype(float), frame.dimensions, edges, plan)
                max_bond = max(max_bond, longest)
                side = 1 if xyz[1, 2] > xyz[[7, 11], 2].mean() else -1
                sides.append(side)
                anchor = xyz[0]; peg = xyz[12:]; mass = chain.masses[12:]
                height = side*(peg[:, 2]-anchor[2]); center = np.average(peg, axis=0, weights=mass)
                mean_height = float(np.average(height, weights=mass))
                rg = float(np.sqrt(np.average(np.sum((peg-center)**2, axis=1), weights=mass)))
                rows.append([float(height[-1]), mean_height, rg]); heights.append(height)
                individual.append([float(frame.time), index, side, float(height[-1]), mean_height, rg])
                shapes.append((xyz-anchor)*[1, 1, side])
            if initial_sides is None:
                initial_sides = np.asarray(sides)
                if [sum(initial_sides > 0), sum(initial_sides < 0)] != [count//2, count//2]:
                    raise ValueError("Unexpected graft count per leaflet")
            changes += int(np.sum(np.asarray(sides) != initial_sides))
            rows = np.asarray(rows)
            records.append([float(frame.time), area, (count//2)/area, *rows.mean(axis=0),
                            float(np.std(rows[:, 0], ddof=0))])
            height_frames.append(heights); final_shapes = shapes
        values = np.asarray(records); individuals = np.asarray(individual)
        heights = np.asarray(height_frames)
        if len(values) != 201 or not np.allclose(values[:, 0], np.arange(201)*100):
            raise ValueError("Expected 201 frames from 0 to 20000 ps")
        late = values[:, 0] >= 10000
        labels = ["area_nm2", "graft_density_per_leaflet_nm-2", "tip_height_nm",
                  "mass_mean_height_nm", "PEG_Rg_nm", "within_frame_tip_sd_nm"]
        summary = {"PEL_fraction_percent": fraction, "grafts_per_leaflet": count//2,
                   "total_beads": atoms, "water_beads": waters, "NA": count,
                   "frames": 201, "late_frames": int(late.sum()), "PEG_beads_per_chain": 51,
                   "PEG_model_mass_u": float(sum(chains[0].masses[12:])),
                   "maximum_bond_nm": max_bond, "leaflet_membership_changes": changes,
                   "initial": dict(zip(labels, values[0, 1:].tolist())),
                   "last10ns": {name: stats(values[late, i+1]) for i, name in enumerate(labels)}}
        summaries.append(summary); all_arrays.append(values); all_chains.append(individuals)
        all_heights.append(heights[late])
        with (args.out/f"fraction-{fraction}.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            writer = csv.writer(f); writer.writerow(["time_ps", *labels]); writer.writerows(values)
        with (args.out/f"chains-{fraction}.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            writer = csv.writer(f); writer.writerow(["time_ps", "chain_index", "leaflet_side", "tip_height_nm", "mass_mean_height_nm", "PEG_Rg_nm"]); writer.writerows(individuals)
        last = individuals[individuals[:, 0] == 20000]
        selected = np.argsort(last[:, 3])[[0, len(last)//2, -1]]
        for index in selected:
            snapshots.append({"fraction_percent": fraction, "chain_index": int(index),
                              "selection": "minimum, median-index, or maximum terminal height at 20 ns",
                              "tip_height_nm": last[index, 3], "mass_mean_height_nm": last[index, 4],
                              "coordinates_relative_to_graft_nm": final_shapes[index].tolist(),
                              "names": chains[index].names.tolist(), "bonds": plans[index][0].tolist()})
    # Normalize each chain by its model mass, then average chains and frames.
    pooled = np.concatenate([v.ravel() for v in all_heights])
    bins = np.arange(np.floor(pooled.min()/.25)*.25-.25, np.ceil(pooled.max()/.25)*.25+.5, .25)
    mass = np.array([45]*50+[36], dtype=float); mass /= mass.sum()
    densities = []
    for heights in all_heights:
        weights = np.broadcast_to(mass, heights.shape).ravel()/np.prod(heights.shape[:2])
        density, _ = np.histogram(heights.ravel(), bins=bins, weights=weights)
        density /= np.diff(bins)
        if not np.isclose(np.sum(density*np.diff(bins)), 1, atol=1e-12):
            raise ValueError("Height probability density must integrate to one")
        densities.append(density)
    summary = {"window_ps": [10000, 20000], "models": summaries,
               "height_reference": "Signed outward displacement from the NH3-named attachment bead",
               "height_distribution": "PEG bead model-mass probability density; normalized per chain, then averaged across chains and saved frames",
               "time_sd": "Sample SD of frame means, ddof=1; chains within a frame are not independent replicates",
               "height_probability_integrals": [float(np.sum(v*np.diff(bins))) for v in densities]}
    (args.out/"summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    (args.out/"snapshots.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshots), encoding="utf-8")
    np.savetxt(args.out/"height-probability.csv", np.column_stack(((bins[:-1]+bins[1:])/2, *densities)),
               delimiter=",", header="height_nm,fraction5_per_nm,fraction25_per_nm", comments="")
    colors = ["#147d92", "#c66b43"]; labels = ["5% PEL", "25% PEL"]
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 8), sharex=True, constrained_layout=True)
    for values, color, label in zip(all_arrays, colors, labels):
        axs[0].plot(values[:, 0]/1000, values[:, 1], c=color, label=label)
        axs[1].plot(values[:, 0]/1000, values[:, 2], c=color, label=label)
    axs[0].set_ylabel("膜面投影面积 / nm²" if zh else "Projected area / nm²")
    axs[1].set_ylabel("每叶片接枝密度 / nm⁻²" if zh else "Graft density per leaflet\n/ nm⁻²")
    axs[1].set_xlabel("生产阶段时间 / ns" if zh else "Production time / ns")
    axs[0].legend(ncol=2); axs[0].set_title("接枝数与实际面积共同决定面密度" if zh else "Graft count and actual area jointly define surface density")
    for ax in axs: ax.axvspan(10, 20, color="#e8d5ac", alpha=.2); ax.grid(alpha=.15)
    save(fig, args.out/"graft-geometry")
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(12, 10), sharex=True, constrained_layout=True)
    names = ["PEG质量平均高度 / nm", "末端平均高度 / nm", "PEG平均回转半径 / nm"] if zh else ["Mean PEG mass height\n/ nm", "Mean terminal height\n/ nm", "Mean PEG radius of gyration\n/ nm"]
    for values, color, label in zip(all_arrays, colors, labels):
        for ax, column in zip(axs, [4, 3, 5]):ax.plot(values[:, 0]/1000, values[:, column], c=color, label=label)
    for ax, name in zip(axs, names):ax.set_ylabel(name);ax.axvspan(10, 20, color="#e8d5ac", alpha=.2);ax.grid(alpha=.15)
    axs[0].legend(ncol=2);axs[-1].set_xlabel("生产阶段时间 / ns" if zh else "Production time / ns")
    axs[0].set_title("高度、末端与整体尺寸的不同变化" if zh else "Height, terminal position, and overall size evolve differently")
    save(fig, args.out/"brush-height")
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 9), constrained_layout=True)
    centers = (bins[:-1]+bins[1:])/2
    tips = [v[v[:, 0] >= 10000, 3] for v in all_chains]
    tip_bins = np.linspace(min(v.min() for v in tips)-.1, max(v.max() for v in tips)+.1, 35)
    for density, tip, color, label in zip(densities, tips, colors, labels):
        axs[0].plot(centers, density, color=color, lw=2.2, label=label)
        axs[1].hist(tip, bins=tip_bins, density=True, histtype="step", color=color, lw=2.2, label=label)
    axs[0].set(xlabel="距接枝点向外高度 / nm" if zh else "Outward height from the attachment bead / nm",
               ylabel="质量加权概率密度 / nm⁻¹" if zh else "Mass-weighted probability\ndensity / nm⁻¹")
    axs[1].set(xlabel="末端高度 / nm" if zh else "Terminal height / nm",
               ylabel="概率密度 / nm⁻¹" if zh else "Probability density / nm⁻¹")
    axs[0].legend(ncol=2); axs[0].set_title("后10ns：逐链归一化后的高度分布" if zh else "Final 10 ns: height distributions normalized per chain")
    for ax in axs:ax.axvline(0, c="#999999", lw=1);ax.grid(alpha=.15)
    save(fig, args.out/"brush-distribution")
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 9), constrained_layout=True)
    vmin = min(v[:, 3].min() for v in all_chains); vmax = max(v[:, 3].max() for v in all_chains)
    for ax, chain_values, label in zip(axs, all_chains, labels):
        n = len(np.unique(chain_values[:, 1]));matrix = chain_values[:, 3].reshape(201, n).T
        im = ax.imshow(matrix, origin="lower", aspect="auto", extent=[0, 20, -.5, n-.5],
                       vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax, cmap="viridis", interpolation="nearest")
        ax.set_title(label);ax.set_ylabel("链编号" if zh else "Chain index");ax.set_xlabel("时间 / ns" if zh else "Time / ns")
    fig.colorbar(im, ax=axs, label="末端向外高度 / nm" if zh else "Outward terminal height / nm", shrink=.85)
    save(fig, args.out/"brush-chains")
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

读取两组TPR/XTC，用显式键图遍历、质量权重和统一统计窗口生成结果。

### 从参考记录生成双语图和数据表

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
python analyze_brush.py --low records/5 --high records/25 --out results-zh --language zh
python analyze_brush.py --low records/5 --high records/25 --out results-en --language en
```

每组records目录包含md.tpr与md.xtc；输出目录分别保存中英文图。

运行分析时，两组目录各自提供md.tpr和md.xtc即可；前者让程序知道珠子属于哪条分子、质量是多少、哪些珠子有键相连，后者提供逐帧位置与盒子。输出目录中的CSV保留未经文字取舍的逐帧数值，汇总JSON保存窗口和平均定义，图像则适合并排观察。要比较一个新的接枝比例，先检查分子组成和链长度，再调整脚本中对应的组成断言与输入目录。这样修改的是明确的比较对象，几何计算和统计定义仍有可追踪的连续性。

要继续研究接枝密度的影响，一个有用的下一步是在每个比例下准备数个独立构型，其中既有较紧凑也有较伸展的链，再比较各重复的高度分布是否逐渐接近。若目标是蛋白靠近表面的过程，则需要加入具有合适参数的蛋白，明确其初始位置、取向和接近坐标，同时记录水与聚合物的重排。若目标是弯曲载体，还要将平面膜扩展为曲率明确的几何结构。每一次扩展都对应一个新的物理对象和测量量，而已有的接枝密度与高度定义可以继续沿用。

读完这一节，面对“表面接了更多PEG”这样的描述，就可以进一步问出三个具体问题：每片表面实际有多少条链、每条链的质量主要分布在哪里、不同链和不同时间之间差别有多大。本例给出了两种配方在各自20 ns记录中的答案，也展示了初始构象如何留在演化曲线中。把分子身份、空间参考点和统计平均连起来，才能从一张看上去蓬松的分子图片，走向能够比较、能够复算、也能够继续设计实验的界面结构描述。
